summary: CAFGU Active Auxiliary members Samsamin Labay Kabagani and Danny Minandang and their civilian companion Esmael Manabilang, a wood gatherer, were riding two motorcycles from Barangay Barurao, Sultan sa Barongis, towards the Army's Bud Wire detachment when gunmen waiting by the national highway opened fire on them at Sitio Philippine Trade, Barangay Manungkaling, Mamasapano, Maguindanao del Sur, at about 10:40 a.m. on Saturday, 7 November 2026. Kabagani and Minandang died at the scene; Manabilang was declared dead on arrival at the Bangsamoro Regional Hospital and Medical Center. Mohamidin Udal Usman, 18, was hit in the crossfire and was in stable condition. The gunmen fled on motorcycles; the Army said the attack may have been tied to the militiamen's work, and police named a person of interest from an armed group.
